key_takeaways: 실데이터 부족 시 합성 데이터 사용으로 인한 편향 및 신뢰성 저하 문제 지적

en.title: Learning a Size-Weight Frontier for Synthetic-Augmented Inference
en.hook: Overcoming bias and unreliability when treating synthetic data as real data in statistical inference.
key_takeaways: Addresses bias and unreliability caused by naive use of synthetic data
Develops a generative framework to learn an optimal size-weight frontier
Improves statistical inference accuracy under data scarcity constraints

zh.title: 学习用于合成增强推理的大小-权重边界
zh.hook: 解决在统计推断中将合成数据直接视为真实数据所带来的偏差与不可靠性问题。
key_takeaways: 指出直接盲目使用合成样本带来的偏差与不可靠推断问题
通过学习大小-权重边界优化合成数据的生成与融合策略
在真实数据稀缺的情况下显著提升统计推断的准确性
